# Setup mock source
mkdir mock-source/skill1
-- mock-source/axen.json --
{
  "axen_version": "1",
  "name": "mock-source",
  "skills": {
    "skill1": { "path": "skill1" }
  }
}
-- mock-source/skill1/SKILL.md --
# Skill 1

# Test 1: Local relative paths are expanded to absolute in axen-lock.json
exec axen source add ./mock-source
exec grep '"source": ".*/mock-source"' $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.axen/axen-lock.json

# Test 2: GitHub shorthands that don't exist fail with github shorthand error
! exec axen source add nonexistentuser/nonexistentrepo
stderr 'Failed to fetch shorthand from GitHub'
